findings.title: Extraction context cache is bound to GEMINI_EXTRACTION_MODEL only and does not rebuild per fallback model.
findings.note: Dormant today because GEMINI_EXTRACTION_FALLBACKS defaults to []. Must mirror synthesis per-model rebuild before any extraction fallback model is configured. Tracked in artifacts/issues/hi8-system-instruction-context-cache.md.

findings.title: Synthesis cache create has a small race on cold (kind, model) slot
findings.note: Two threads can both call client.caches.create on first warm-up; the loser cache lives until TTL. Same pattern as extraction; cost negligible.
